newsitem.title: UK: RUSSIA'S NOVOROSSISK REOPENS AFTER STORM CLOSURE.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA'S NOVOROSSISK REOPENS AFTER STORM CLOSURE.

text.p: The Russian Black Sea terminal of Novorossiisk was open on Thursday after closing for three hours early on Wednesday afternoon due to a thunderstorm, a shipping souirce said.
The K. Asparukh and Arteaga carrying Russian Export Blend crude and the Lipetsk carrying gas oil had sailed in the past 24 hours and the Seascout, due to carry crude, was alongside, the source said.
The main crude pipeline to the port, which can carry 90,000 tonnes per day, reopened late on Friday following repairs.
Operations at other Black Sea and Baltic ports --- Batumi, Odessa, Tuapse and Ventspils -- which handle Russian crude were all running as normal on Thursday, the source said.
